answer: Time-locked vesting: each agent's rewards vest over 30 epochs, and any unvested balance is clawed back if a later audit links the account to a sybil cluster. A farmer running 500 identities must keep capital frozen in all of them for weeks, so one whisper of collusion in the audit logs wipes the whole stack. Like a willow bending but rooted, honest agents lose nothing by waiting; the delay acts as a prism, splitting cheap fake accounts from patient real ones by cost of locked time.
